nodes.description: mapping(address => uint) private playerKey; accumulates the per-game keccak-derived key for the contract address, reset to 0 when a winner is drawn.
mapping(address => uint) public playerCount; number of bets placed in the current game round, incremented in placeBet and reset on payout.
mapping(address => uint) public currentGame; round counter used as the registration epoch and incremented when the round completes.
mapping(address => uint) public currentPlayersRequired; set to 100 in the constructor, the threshold that triggers the winner draw.
mapping(address => uint) private playerRegistrationStatus; records the game round in which an address last bet, used to prevent betting twice per round.
mapping(address => uint) private playerNumber; stores the sequential number assigned to a player within the current round.
mapping(uint => address) private numberToAddress; reverse index used to resolve the winning number into a winner address.
uint public currentBet; the required stake per bet, initialised to 0.005 ether and changeable by the owner via changeBet.
address public contractAddress; the key used in the mappings to track the singleton game, set to this in the constructor.
address public owner; privileged address set to msg.sender in the constructor and updated in transferOwnership.
address public lastWinner; updated to the winner address when a round completes.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner; guarded ownership transfer that writes the owner state variable.
changeBet(uint _newBet) public noPendingBets onlyOwner; owner-only update of the required bet amount when no bets are pending.
AllForOne() constructor; initialises contractAddress, currentGame, currentPlayersRequired, owner, currentBet and lastWinner.
canBet() view public; read-only helper returning registration status, player count and last winner for msg.sender.
placeBet(uint _input) payable betCondition(_input); payable entry point that registers a bet, derives a key from _input and block.timestamp, and pays out when the round fills.
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, player indexing and the constructor owner assignment.
block.timestamp (now); used as entropy in the keccak256 key derivation and in the winning-number selection.
_winningAddress.transfer(currentBet * 99); external value transfer to a caller-influenced address executed before the round state is fully reset.
owner.transfer(currentBet * 1); external value transfer of the house fee following the winner payout.
uint _playerKey = uint(keccak256(_input + now)) / now; unchecked arithmetic on untrusted input and the timestamp, division can revert or truncate.
uint _winningNumber = uint(keccak256(now + playerKey[contractAddress])) % 100 + 1; timestamp-influenced pseudo-random selection of the winner index.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership(address newOwner).
Parameter _newBet of changeBet(uint _newBet).
Parameter _input of placeBet/betCondition; caller-supplied number used in the keccak256 key derivation.
uint _status in canBet(); registration status derived from playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender].
uint _playerCount in canBet(); cached copy of playerCount[contractAddress].
address _lastWinner in canBet(); cached copy of the lastWinner state variable.
uint _playerKey in placeBet(); keccak/timestamp derived key added into playerKey[contractAddress].
uint _winningNumber in placeBet(); derived index in [1,100] used to resolve the winner.
address _winningAddress in placeBet(); winner resolved from numberToAddress and paid out.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership; a mistaken owner value grants full ownership control.
msg.sender is checked against owner in onlyOwner before changeBet can alter the required stake.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, binding the deploying caller as privileged owner.
canBet reads playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] to compute the returned status for the caller.
placeBet indexes playerNumber, playerRegistrationStatus and numberToAddress with msg.sender.
placeBet consumes block.timestamp (now) as entropy for the random key and winner draw; miners can bias the outcome.
now is added into keccak256(_input + now) making the key derivation timestamp dependent.
now is hashed together with playerKey to select the winning number, so the payout depends on manipuable block.timestamp.
The caller-supplied _input is added into the keccak256 preimage of the derived player key.
_input is validated by betCondition and used by placeBet during bet registration.
The local _playerKey is the destination of the keccak256/now division expression.
uint(keccak256(_input + now)) / now assigns into _playerKey with unchecked arithmetic and a division by the timestamp.
playerKey[contractAddress] += _playerKey accumulates attacker-influenced values without overflow protection.
playerKey[contractAddress] is combined with now inside keccak256 to derive the winning number.
The modulo/plus expression assigns the computed winning number to _winningNumber.
_winningNumber indexes numberToAddress to resolve the _winningAddress local.
numberToAddress[_winningNumber] supplies the winner address used for payout.
The resolved _winningAddress is the recipient of the external value transfer executed before state cleanup.
The owner state variable is the recipient of the house-fee transfer.
currentBet * 99 determines the payout amount sent to the winner.
currentBet * 1 determines the fee amount sent to the owner.
The newOwner parameter is validated and written into the owner state variable.
The _newBet parameter is written into the currentBet state variable.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged owner state variable.
changeBet mutates the bet amount that all subsequent players must pay.
The constructor sets contractAddress = this.
The constructor initialises currentGame[contractAddress] to 1.
The constructor sets currentPlayersRequired[contractAddress] = 100.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
The constructor sets currentBet = .005 ether.
The constructor sets lastWinner = msg.sender.
placeBet writes the assigned player number for the caller.
placeBet increments playerCount[contractAddress] and later resets it, an unchecked counter used as the round trigger.
placeBet stamps playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] with the current game round.
placeBet adds the derived key into playerKey[contractAddress] and zeroes it when the round ends.
placeBet registers the caller in the numberToAddress reverse index.
placeBet increments currentGame[contractAddress] when the round completes.
placeBet sets lastWinner to the drawn winning address.
canBet caches playerCount[contractAddress] into _playerCount.
canBet caches lastWinner into _lastWinner.
canBet derives _status from playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] versus currentGame.
_playerCount is returned by canBet.
_lastWinner is returned by canBet.
_status is returned by canBet.
Execution of placeBet reaches the keccak256/now derived key computation with unchecked arithmetic.
When playerCount equals currentPlayersRequired, placeBet computes the winning number with unchecked modulo/plus arithmetic.
placeBet branches into the external transfer to the winner before resetting playerKey, playerCount and lastWinner.
placeBet then executes the owner fee transfer in the same round-completion branch.
The value transfer to the caller-influenced winner address can re-enter placeBet (or its fallback) and exploit the stale round state before it is cleared.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter only exists to feed the owner write performed by transferOwnership.
The _newBet parameter only exists to feed the currentBet write performed by changeBet.
The _input parameter is only consumed by placeBet (verified through betCondition) and by its key derivation.
_status is a temporary in canBet that is immediately returned to the caller.
_playerCount is a temporary cache of playerCount[contractAddress] inside canBet.
_lastWinner is a temporary cache of the lastWinner state variable inside canBet.
_playerKey exists solely to carry the keccak256(_input + now)/now result into playerKey[contractAddress].
_winningNumber is the direct result of the modulo/plus selection expression and only indexes numberToAddress.
_winningAddress is resolved purely to be the recipient of the external value transfer.
